Advertisement for the post of Digital Media Designer
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for the following temporary posts in
Research Project entitled “Climate, Health and Air Monitoring Project”. Posts is purely on
contract basis and co-terminus with the term period of the project.
Post: Digital Media Designer
Qualification:
Essential: Diploma or Degree in Graphic Designing / Animation / Mass Communication /
Applied Arts / Allied discipline.
Desirable:
Having working experience in Script/Content Writing (Hindi/English), Adobe Premiere Pro,
Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe after Effect, Adobe InDesign and related software,
AI Generative Tools like Runway ML, Envato Elements, Sora, short format content creation,
social media analytics, camera handling.
• Candidate should provide at least 1 recommendation letter and work experience in same
field.
a) Salary: Rs. 31000/- per month (fixed)
b) Job Description:
• A self-motivated, multi-skilled candidate is sought to join the project having good
knowledge of Graphic Design Skills, brainstorming creative designing ideas, Good
interpersonal skills, Ability to Work in Strict Deadlines, Researching and preparing rough
drafts.
• Should be able to manage social media account for wider reach of IEC material.
• Able to understand brief provided and create high quality visual within given timelines
• Candidate should be available for immediate joining, if selected
Hardcopy of Applications along with bio-data and attested copies of certificates and work
experience etc should reach to the undersigned latest by 8 November 2025 before 2.00 pm in
room no 227, Department of Environment Studies, Panjab University Chandigarh. The
application form can be downloaded from Panjab University jobs website link
(https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/list-jobs.php). Only submitted hardcopy will be considered and
no application via email will be considered.
Candidate should also fill the google form https://forms.gle/ArWqH6P6WN3jE2i59
before submitting application with document in the office The interview date and time will be
informed through email to shortlisted candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the
interview. The rules and regulations as laid down by Panjab University and/or funding agency
will govern the selected candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Professor & Principal Investigator E. Mail: sumanmor@pu.ac.in
